name: kitty
summary: GPU terminal for macOS and Linux with native custom shaders, background images, blur, splits layout, sessions, remote control and the kitty graphics protocol.

windows.notes: No native Windows build; the install docs cover macOS and Linux only. WSL users can run the Linux build under WSLg, which is not a supported primary path and is unverified here. On Windows use Windows Terminal or WezTerm.

install.notes: Package id is the common cask name; not listed on the official install page (unverified).
Official binary installer (curl ... | sh); installs to /Applications/kitty.app. Re-run to update.

macos.notes: Config search order: $KITTY_CONFIG_DIRECTORY, then $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/kitty/kitty.conf, ~/.config/kitty/kitty.conf, $XDG_CONFIG_DIRS/kitty/kitty.conf. The `kitty` binary lives at /Applications/kitty.app/Contents/MacOS/kitty if not on PATH. No dedicated config validator exists in the docs read; a reload (ctrl+cmd+,) or `debug_config` (ctrl+shift+f6) shows errors.

install.notes: Distro package name is the standard one; not listed on the official install page (unverified).
Debian/Ubuntu package; may lag the latest release. Unverified on the official page.
Fedora package. Unverified on the official page.
Official binary installer (curl ... | sh); installs to ~/.local/kitty.app; symlink kitty and kitten into ~/.local/bin.

linux.notes: Works on X11 and Wayland. Prefer the official installer when the distro version is older than 0.49 (custom shaders) or 0.42 (quick access terminal). No dedicated config validator exists in the docs read.

background-animated.notes: Via bundled or custom shaders (0.49+); animated image files are not documented.

shader.notes: custom_shaders, official since 0.49. Slang shaders, not GLSL.

profiles.notes: No profile concept. Use `include other.conf` plus `kitty --config <file>` or `-o key=value` per launch, and session files for tab/window setups.
